pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: sim/matrices/heavy.toml:11 The heavy matrix, described as "the full calibration grid", varies the core tier (haiku/sonnet/opus) as an axis but fixes effort as one scalar at Low, the lowest of the five Effort values; every other matrix does the same, so the effort half of the core_thread route is never measured and stays at an extreme with no evidence behind it.

techniques.evidence: sim/matrices/heavy.toml:11 The rule is to default the dial to the middle and move it only on evidence. Matrix.core_effort is a scalar (crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/matrix.rs:52), not an axis. All 9 matrices in the context pin it to low, so no tournament can measure effort. Tier calibration itself is done by measurement: core_tiers is an axis in pilot, night and heavy.
